meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 比较和可视化树状亲缘关系，生成科研论文级图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果研究物种演化，需要把树形关系整理成清晰的图。
copy.tagline_en: Compare and render phylogenetic trees for polished scientific figures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study evolution and often need visual comparisons for your papers.

howto.what: 能读取、修剪、重定根并比较系统发育树(Newick、NHX 等),检测基因树里的复制与物种分化事件、区分直系与旁系同源,挂接 NCBI 分类信息,并输出 PDF/SVG 树图。
howto.when: 当你读写 Newick 等树文件、编辑或比较树拓扑、检测基因树进化事件或查 NCBI 分类出图时接管;它不能从原始序列推断树,需先比对建树。

say.text: 用 ete3 读取 tree.nw,统计叶子数和节点数
say.note: 输出叶子数、节点数等统计

say.text: 把这棵树做中点定根,再剪成只保留这三个物种
say.note: 输出重定根并修剪后的树

howto.what_en: Reads, prunes, reroots and compares phylogenetic trees (Newick, NHX, PhyloXML), detects duplication and speciation events in gene trees, tells orthologs from paralogs, links NCBI taxonomy, and renders PDF/SVG figures.
howto.when_en: Use it to read/write Newick trees, edit or compare topologies, detect gene-tree events, or query NCBI taxonomy and render figures. It cannot infer trees from raw sequences.
